name: duopore-public-explicit-date-normalizer
description: Put dates into one clear format and catch dates that do not exist.

interface.longDescription: Put dates into one clear format and catch dates that do not exist. Paste dates and tell the app which date order they use. Convert them to year-month-day, such as 2026-10-20. See invalid dates instead of having them guessed or changed. You must choose the date format; the app does not guess day and month order.
defaultPrompt: Convert these day-month-year dates to year-month-day.
Find invalid dates in this list without guessing the format.
